facts.blocked_reason: The three-desktop journey was attempted against this exact candidate and did not reach step one. Three packaged rc29 desktops ran concurrently on one host, each with an isolated profile and its own self-provisioned Nostr identity, so the three-distinct-identities precondition is satisfiable without three machines. Admission is what blocks: a Sarah voice session requires an active alpha-cohort row written only by the owner-run admit-sarah-voice-npub script, and community room access requires NIP-29 kind-9000 admission signed by the group admin key. Both are owner-only and out of band, and no HTTP surface exists for either. With no member admitted, the floor, moderator, shared-answer, and all four refusal observations are unreachable in order. Two of the four refusals are additionally not satisfiable with their expected codes: removeSarahLiveKitRoomMember is the only producer of member_removed and membership_changed and has no non-test caller, and production resolveMember returns undefined for a removed member, which the routes map to 403 room_membership_required.
not_observed: authenticated_desktop_count>=3: three packaged rc29 desktops ran concurrently with three distinct self-provisioned identities, but none completed POST /api/sarah/livekit/room/join
floor_acquired: no member joined, so no server-issued floor lease exists
floor_transfer_completed: a server-issued floor moved between two members
facts.note: This receipt records what was actually observed for one Sarah LiveKit release-gate row on Omega v0.2.0-rc29. It never promotes source tests, configuration, deployment-lifecycle receipts, or a headless harness run into an installed packaged-candidate observation.

observed.headless_subscriber_fanout_composition: one owner participant plus one headless secondary subscriber
observed.packaged_desktop_profile_isolation_route: HOME and --user-data-dir co-located at <root>/Library/Application Support/Omega RC, which makes the rc29 provisioning root and registry root coincide

refused_claims: A subscriberFanoutCount of 2 headless subscribers is NOT a three-desktop journey and is not reported as one.
Passing server-side floor-authority unit tests in apps/openagents.com/workers/api are source evidence and cannot promote an installed-candidate row.
Three launched packaged desktops are NOT three authenticated room participants. Instance count is not admission, and this row records authenticated_room_joins 0.
A self-provisioned Nostr identity is NOT an admitted community member. Self-provisioning clears identity creation only; the alpha-cohort row and the NIP-29 group admission remain owner-only.

The rc29 candidate does NOT carry the --user-data-dir identity fix. Omega ba6cc833b1 landed after the rc29 source c7ecf769e8, so isolated profiles authenticate on this candidate only through the co-located HOME route recorded above, not through the fix.

the gate observation receipt for this row; records all nine observations as not_observed with the specific obstruction for each, produced by an attempted three-desktop run against this exact package digest

facts.unblocks_when: Three authenticated packaged Omega v0.2.0-rc29 desktops join one community room, summon Sarah, transfer the server-issued floor between two members, all hear the shared answer, a moderator stops Sarah, and a non-floor participant, a stale grant, a replay, and a removed member are each refused. Reaching step one first requires three identities to hold both an active sarah_voice_cohort:alpha_v1 row and NIP-29 group admission on the configured community, one of them as group admin so the moderator stop is reachable. The removed-member and stale-grant refusals additionally require member_removed and membership_changed to acquire a production emitter, or the expected codes to be amended to the codes the deployed routes actually return.
